content.name: Fence
children:
roles:
  - name: alice
    login: true
  - name: reporting_app
    login: true
  - name: orders_reader

grants:
  - role: orders_reader
    privileges: [USAGE]
    object: { type: schema, name: app }
  - role: orders_reader
    privileges: [SELECT]
    object: { type: table, schema: app, name: orders }

memberships:
  - role: orders_reader
    members:
      - name: alice
      - name: reporting_app
